observation.command: for p in / /index.html /maildev /static /api/health /email; do printf "%-14s -> " "$p"; curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" "http://localhost:1080$p"; done; echo "=== maildev 1025 smtp ==="; (echo > /dev/tcp/localhost/1025) 2>&1 && echo "smtp port 1025 open" || echo "smtp closed"; echo "=== docker healthcheck def ==="; docker inspect startuphafen-maildev --format '{{json .Config.Healthcheck}}' 2>&1
